limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The exact value of the shift radius R_p remains open for 1<p<infinity, p not equal to 2; no equality with the powered Bohr upper bound is claimed. The result concerns the canonical unilateral shift on ell_p and does not classify general Banach sequence spaces. Older Matsaev-type polynomial-calculus and analytic Toeplitz/convolution literature is the principal residual prior-art risk.
record_title: Powered-Bohr upper bounds and duality for the ell_p shift calculus
